name: linkwarden-mcp
description: MCP server for Linkwarden: read-first bookmark and collection access with opt-in scoped writes.

LINKWARDEN_TOKEN.title: Linkwarden API token
LINKWARDEN_TOKEN.description: Bearer API token from Linkwarden settings.

LINKWARDEN_MCP_WRITE_SCOPES.title: Write scopes
LINKWARDEN_MCP_WRITE_SCOPES.description: Comma-separated domains for create/update: links,collections,tags,raw. Recommended: links,collections. Leave empty for read-only.

LINKWARDEN_MCP_DELETE_SCOPES.title: Delete scopes
LINKWARDEN_MCP_DELETE_SCOPES.description: Comma-separated domains for delete only (never implied by write): links,collections,tags,raw. Leave empty for no deletes.
